description: Readiness gates for the enabled relevance route. Tolerances are proposals until accepted; freeze threshold, batch_size, candidate_fingerprint and holdout_sha256 before any holdout replay. Passing gates is a review verdict, not an activation switch.

G1.name: critical_miss
G1.measure: Critical relevant cases whose workflow selection is not true

G2.name: stratum_recall
G2.measure: Relevant local-negative cases selected; lower 95% Wilson bound

G3.name: overall_recall
G3.measure: Relevant cases selected by the workflow rule; lower 95% Wilson bound

G4.name: precision_benefit
G4.measure: Irrelevant local-negative cases not selected; reported only

G5.name: invariants
G5.measure: Records total and ordered; kept and unknown selections never dropped

G6.name: off_unchanged
G6.measure: Off output identical to the pre-change golden result; no decision client

G7.name: evidence_retained
G7.measure: source_evidence identical between off and enabled for the same input

G8.name: completion
G8.measure: Batches ending in legacy_full from decision errors; invariant failures

G9.name: latency
G9.measure: Paired analysis-stage median reduction with a bootstrap 95% interval excluding 0

G10.name: cost_receipts
G10.measure: Decision requests without a usage cost receipt; missing is never zero

G11.name: rollback
G11.measure: Off restored through the deploy path and read back
